Motion & Voting
Original Main Motion #3: I move the Fairfax County School Board to direct the Superintendent to provide a comprehensive inventory of Generative Artificial Intelligence tools and solutions provided by or through FCPS on FCPS-issued laptops and tablets by November 12, 2026, and to prohibit the use of such Generative AI tools and solutions by students until a formal policy is adopted by the School Board to govern such usage.
Motion by Mateo Dunne, second by Ricardy J Anderson.
Original Amendment to Main Motion #3: I move to amend main motion #3 by striking the motion in its entirety and inserting in its place: I move that the Fairfax County School Board direct the Superintendent to provide a comprehensive inventory of Generative Artificial Intelligence tools and solutions provided by or through FCPS on FCPS-issued laptops and tablets by January 14, 2027, and to prohibit the use of such Generative AI tools and solutions by elementary school students unless specifically authorized in writing.
Motion by Sandy B Anderson, second by Robyn Lady - Chair.
Amendment to Amendment to Main Motion #3: I move to amend the amendment to main motion #3 by inserting the phrase “and will only be permissible for secondary students” after the phrase “elementary school students”.
Motion by Karl V Frisch, second by Mateo Dunne.
Final Resolution: Motion Carries
Yes: Sandy B Anderson, Karl V Frisch, Ilryong Moon, Kyle McDaniel - Vice Chair, Robyn Lady - Chair, Seema Dixit, Mateo Dunne, Tom Dannan, Ricardy J Anderson, Marcia St John-Cunning
No: Melanie K Meren
Amended Amendment to Main Motion #3: I move that the Fairfax County School Board direct the Superintendent to provide a comprehensive inventory by January 14, 2027, and to prohibit use by elementary school students, and allow use only for secondary students unless specifically authorized in writing.
Motion by Sandy B Anderson, second by Robyn Lady - Chair.
Final Resolution: Motion Carries
Yes: Sandy B Anderson, Karl V Frisch, Kyle McDaniel - Vice Chair, Robyn Lady - Chair, Seema Dixit, Mateo Dunne, Tom Dannan, Ricardy J Anderson, Marcia St John-Cunning
No: Melanie K Meren, Ilryong Moon
Amended Main Motion #3: I move that the Fairfax County School Board direct the Superintendent to provide a comprehensive inventory by January 14, 2027, and to prohibit use by elementary school students, and allow use only for secondary students unless specifically authorized in writing, until a formal policy is adopted.
Motion by Mateo Dunne, second by Ricardy J Anderson.
Final Resolution: Motion Carries
Yes: Sandy B Anderson, Karl V Frisch, Kyle McDaniel - Vice Chair, Robyn Lady - Chair, Seema Dixit, Mateo Dunne, Tom Dannan, Ricardy J Anderson, Marcia St John-Cunning
No: Ilryong Moon
